rename.from: Importing module is undefined in development
rename.to: Imported module is undefined in development

body:
Well this is weird, to say the least. I could reproduce it in a fresh project, but not in an example app in this monorepo or in a test (#747). And I'm using imports from node_modules in a production app.

I can only imagine something about CommonJS conversion changed recently in Vite, or esbuild, or something? But I can't seem to figure out what exactly

Since you can't replicate it in this monorepo but you can with new projects, I'm assuming the bug is from a dependency update. Though even weirder, I don't think it's a direct update to Vite or ESBuild—but perhaps one of their dependencies.

To debug, I tried using the same versions for several dependencies as in the svelte/kit monorepo. Did this by manually updating both the package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml. These are the dependencies I tried:

- Vite
- ESBuild
- Svelte
- cheap-watch
- sade
- rollup
- resolve
- postcss

In short, if it is a dependency issue, it's not going to be obvious.

Going to see if I can reproduce this with Vite itself.

Note: with more recent versions of ESBuild, there are breaking changes that affect CommonJS modules. (https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.10.0, https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.11.0). However, Vite does not support v0.10.0, and my pnpm-lock.yaml uses 0.9.7. So this should not be the issue.
Not sure if this helps, but after removing `noExternal: Object.keys(pkg.dependencies || {})` from `svelte.config.cjs`, it suddenly works.

It might be the same issue but I'm not sure. During development ``` import pc from "@prisma/client" // Cannot read property 'PrismaClient' of undefined ``` ``` import * as pc from "@prisma/client" // ✔ ``` During production build the opposite works ``` import pc from "@prisma/client" // ✔ ``` ``` import * as pc from "@prisma/client" // Cannot read property 'PrismaClient' of undefined ``` Currently working around this by keeping an uncommitted local change. In my case I have already disabled the noExternal line, which solved a similar import issue I had with `bytes`:

> @n4bb12 I ended up doing something similar, except making it dependent on `NODE_ENV` and therefore being able to commit it:

Thanks but that's unfortunately not fixing `Cannot read property 'PrismaClient' of undefined`. Feel free to try it out yourself.

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**

Cannot build Sveltekit while using Sharp and the Vercel adapter. Sharp works in development. I suspect this issue applies to all dependencies with `.node` files.

This seems unrelated to the ["error when including packages"](https://kit.svelte.dev/faq#packages) question in the FAQ or https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/issues/737

```bash
    4 │ const sharp = require('../build/Release/sharp.node');
```

1. Initialize new Sveltekit project

body: I couldn't reproduce the original issue with the latest version. If anyone are still experiencing this, please open another issue with a complete and minimal reproducible example.

This issue has just occured for me importing a smaller package called Steps https://github.com/shaozi/svelte-steps. When importing through the recommended means `import { Steps } from 'svelte-steps';` I'd use the component in the html and get the error

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/69179091/211528753-da209e30-5d81-43c8-acdd-b432a8970dc7.png)

managed to fix this issue by doing what you stated above (`import * as Steps from 'svelte-steps';`) then the component in the html is `<Steps.Steps />`

An interesting note is that if I commented out the component in the code and loaded the webpage, then uncommented and saved it, the component would work. It wasn't until I refreshed the page that it would crash again. I assume its because its reimporting on refresh.

Sorry I don't have a reproducible example at this stage but thought It would be good to at least note the fact that this issue is still occuring

issue.title: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND after adding a dependency to skeleton project
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

```
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '/home/fitzpasd/repos/s-app/node_modules/@typedorm/common/esm/public-api' imported from /home/fitzpasd/repos/s-app/node_modules/@typedorm/common/esm/index.js
```

The above error is thrown after minimal changes to the skeleton project.  See reproduction repo.

I believe this is not caused by vite as it does not repro with a skeleton project there - https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-jauati?file=src/main.ts

Some observations:
- This isn't for all dependencies (I can `npm i marked --save` and use as expected).
- Looks similar to to #737, which was closed as non-repro without any details on how it was fixed.

Here's the source of `node_modules/@typedorm/common/esm/index.js:` 
```javascript
export * from './public-api';
export * from './private-api';
```

Worth noting that it does not repro if the above is changed to:
```javascript
export * from './public-api.js';
export * from './private-api.js';
```

However I believe the above change shouldn't be necessary and the original source could should be supported here.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/Fitzpasd/sveltekit-module-resolution-error

_No response_
